mapper.sql: JOIN BOOK_ITEM bi ON r.ITEM_ID = bi.ITEM_ID JOIN BOOK b ON bi.BOOK_ID = b.BOOK_ID
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO RENT(USER_ID, ITEM_ID, RENT_DATE, DUE_DATE, RETURN_DATE) VALUES (#{userId}, #{itemId}, SYSDATE, SYSDATE + 7, NULL)
mapper.select: SELECT r.RENT_ID, b.TITLE, r.RENT_DATE, r.RETURN_DATE, r.USER_ID, r.ITEM_ID, r.DUE_DATE FROM RENT r
